title: Publish Privacy, Terms, and Support links (GitHub Issues for now)
description:
## Problem
The marketing footer says product account, privacy, and support surfaces will be published before GA. There are no Privacy, Terms, or Support destination pages/links suitable for launch. Visitors have nowhere obvious to go for legal or help.

## Decisions (locked — do not reopen)
1. Add first-party **Privacy** and **Terms** pages under the marketing Next.js app (`web/`), linked from the shared `Footer`.
2. Add a **Support** footer link. **For this task**, Support goes to GitHub Issues: `https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chattic.us/issues` (same destination as existing \"Open an issue\", but labeled Support in a Legal/Company column so it is discoverable).
3. Replace the footer disclaimer that promises privacy/support \"before general availability\" with copy that points to the new Privacy / Terms / Support links and states we are in **beta**.
4. Do **not** build a new support ticket product in this task. A separate story tracks replacing GitHub Issues with a first-party support inbox stored in product data (waitlist-like).

## Files / area (hypothesis — verify)
- `web/components/Footer.tsx`
- New routes e.g. `web/app/privacy/page.tsx`, `web/app/terms/page.tsx` (or equivalent app-router paths)
- Shared layout/header/footer patterns used by other marketing pages (`/beta`, `/features/*`)

## Content requirements
- Privacy and Terms must be real beta-appropriate pages (not \"lorem\" / \"coming soon\"). Cover: what the marketing site collects (footer currently claims no signup form data on marketing — reconcile with waitlist/beta forms), Cognito/Google sign-in, customer-owned AWS / MIT framing at a high level, contact via Support/GitHub Issues. Keep tone consistent with chattic.us brand guidelines (`docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md`).
- No emojis in UI copy.
- Do not invent fake company legal addresses. If a physical address is unknown, omit it rather than fabricate.

## Done when
- Footer links to Privacy, Terms, and Support
- Pages render on desktop and mobile
- Old \"will be published before GA\" disclaimer is gone
- Lint/typecheck for touched web code passes
